_notes: Spanish voices, for python3 tools/voice/generate.py --locale es. Same fields as cast.json; the clips go to voice/es/<character>/<clip>.mp3, and the words come from translations/es.po.

Fill in voice_name and voice_id for each speaker with a Spanish-speaking LuvVoice voice (python3 tools/voice/generate.py --list-voices standard, or cloned). A speaker with no voice_id is skipped, so you can try a few first.
english_voice is the voice that speaker has in cast.json, for reference only; nothing reads it.
voice_type 'cloned' for cloned and Featured public custom voices, 'standard' otherwise.

pronunciations._notes: Whole-word replacements in the text sent to LuvVoice only. A Spanish voice reads most names right as written (Nefi, Lehi, Lamán); add any it gets wrong.

variables._notes: Values a {{variable}} in a line can take. Each line using one gets a clip per value, named <ID>__<value>.mp3. For example "fruit": ["apples", "figs"], for a line like "These are delicious {{fruit}}." In Spanish the words each value puts into the line are its translation in es.po.

narrator.description: Older Nephi reading the scripture scroll verses (story/scriptures.gd), as in the intro narration. Clips are named by verse key, e.g. voice/narrator/1_nephi_17_8.mp3.

nephi.description: Young Nephi, the player. Faithful, earnest, respectful to his father.

lehi.description: The prophet and father. Old, warm, deep and steady.

sariah.description: Nephi's mother. Warm, tired from the journey, quietly faithful. Needs a mature woman's voice.

laman.description: Eldest brother. Scornful and sarcastic until humbled.

lemuel.description: Second brother, follows Laman's lead, whiny.

sam.description: Third brother, loyal to Nephi, cheerful.

jacob.description: Youngest brother, born in the wilderness; a young child. Needs a child's voice, or an adult voice with pitch raised.

joseph.description: Jacob's younger brother, also born in the wilderness; the smallest child. Should be distinguishable from Jacob.

zoram.description: Laban's former servant from Jerusalem. Loyal, grateful, a bit of an outsider.

ishmael_wife.description: Ishmael's widow. Older woman, gentle and a little grieving; should be distinguishable from Sariah.

ishmael_son_1.description: Ishmael's elder son. Sides with Laman, skeptical and grudging.

ishmael_son_2.description: Ishmael's younger son. Friends with Laman and Lemuel, easygoing, wants to rest and party.

ishmael_daughter_1.description: Ishmael's eldest daughter, Zoram's wife. Composed, admiring.

ishmael_daughter_2.description: Laman's wife. Frank and practical, a little wry about her husband.

ishmael_daughter_4.description: Lemuel's wife. Hopeful but a little exasperated.

ishmael_daughter_5.description: Nephi's wife (she calls him husband). Warm, proud of him, caring. The most prominent of the daughters.

sister_1.description: Nephi's sister, the older of the two. Cheerful, dreamy, looking forward to the voyage. A girl or young woman.

sister_2.description: Nephi's younger sister. Excited about collecting shells; childlike.

sheep.description: Baa. Use a real sheep sound effect.

goat.description: Maaa. Use a real goat sound effect.

chicken.description: Bawk. Use a real chicken sound effect.
